Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: Represents an alert submitted by a user.

description.description: Detailed description of the incident or alert.

category.description: Category of the alert (e.g., Security, Road, Power, Water, Health, Other).

location.description: Location of the incident (neighborhood/area in Goma).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the alert was created.

userId.description: The ID of the user who submitted the alert.

audioUrl.description: A data URI of the recorded audio report.

definition.description: Collection of alerts. Includes fields like title, description, category, location, status, and createdAt. The 'userId' field contains the UID of the user who created the alert.
